entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: "How long will you speak these [things], And the words of your mouth [be like] a strong wind?

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Does God subvert judgment? Or does the Almighty pervert justice?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If your sons have sinned against Him, He has cast them away for their transgression.

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: If you would earnestly seek God And make your supplication to the Almighty,

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: If you [were] pure and upright, Surely now He would awake for you, And prosper your rightful dwelling place.

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: Though your beginning was small, Yet your latter end would increase abundantly.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: ¶"For inquire, please, of the former age, And consider the things discovered by their fathers;

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: For we [were born] yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days on earth [are] a shadow.

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Will they not teach you and tell you, And utter words from their heart?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: "Can the papyrus grow up without a marsh? Can the reeds flourish without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: While it [is] yet green [and] not cut down, It withers before any [other] plant.

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So [are] the paths of all who forget God; And the hope of the hypocrite shall perish,

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: Whose confidence shall be cut off, And whose trust [is] a spider's web.

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He leans on his house, but it does not stand. He holds it fast, but it does not endure.

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He grows green in the sun, And his branches spread out in his garden.

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots wrap around the rock heap, [And] look for a place in the stones.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he is destroyed from his place, Then [it] will deny him, [saying], 'I have not seen you.'

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: "Behold, this is the joy of His way, And out of the earth others will grow.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: ¶Behold, God will not cast away the blameless, Nor will He uphold the evildoers.

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: He will yet fill your mouth with laughing, And your lips with rejoicing.

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, And the dwelling place of the wicked will come to nothing."
